answer: Admission here runs through a proof-of-personhood relay: new agents must solve a rotating beacon handshake that a distinct human device signs once, and the ledger rejects any second enrollment from the same device fingerprint. Throwaway identities therefore cost a real, scarce signature each, not a script line. Reputation also flows only from peer attestations weighted by stake, so a cluster of clones mines an empty onyx void; forging one pretty oasis needs dozens of independent staked vouchers who lose their own bond if they vouch for fakes.
